row.evidence: When I Work's Premium plan ($8/user/month) adds 'API key access' and 'SAML/SSO'; no SCIM is offered on any plan, and users are added by invite, spreadsheet import, payroll/HR integrations (e.g. Rippling) or the REST API.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM endpoint found on the pricing page, in the help centre (326 articles listed in the sitemap), or in the public OpenAPI spec. SAML SSO and API key access are listed on Premium ($8/user/mo) vs Essentials $2.50 and Pro $5; billing period for the listed prices is not stated (page says monthly or annual billing options) and the page also has a Time Tracking & Attendance toggle, so prices may be the scheduling-only figure. API access needs an eligible plan by contacting When I Work. SAML sign-in needs the user to already exist with a matching email (no JIT documented). Okta's catalogue app is SWA only; for Azure the vendor recommends a non-gallery app. Rippling's payroll integration syncs, creates, updates and archives users via API (HRIS sync, not an IdP SCIM connector). Category: workforce scheduling/time clock filed under HR.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 'API key access', 'Webhooks' and 'SAML/SSO' are listed as Premium additions over Pro; sso/user_api false on lower tiers is inferred from that list.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented anywhere searched (see searched).

auth.notes: Developer key (W-Key) plus a When I Work user's email/password returns a JWT used as Bearer/W-Token; W-UserId header selects the account.

capabilities.notes: DELETE /2/users/{id} archives the user ('can be reversed'), so it is recorded as both deactivate and delete; no documented restore endpoint.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks are listed as a Premium addition on the pricing page.

rate_limits.text: Rate limiting on rolling time windows; limits return 403-level errors. Thresholds not published.

limitations.text: API access requires contacting When I Work to confirm an eligible plan; an upgrade may be needed.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks only SWA as checked (no SAML, no SCIM).

entra.notes: Vendor recommends a non-gallery Azure app for SAML.

onelogin.notes: Vendor lists OneLogin as a supported SAML IdP; OneLogin catalogue not checked (blocks bots).

fallbacks.other_sync: Rippling payroll integration creates, updates and archives users from Rippling via API; ADP/Square/Gusto/Paychex payroll integrations (ADP can create users)
